read.thesis: Walmart raised FY27 sales guidance to 4.9%-5.2% and adj. operating income to 8.0%-8.6%, but mix shift to higher-margin ads and membership is driving gains while fuel costs ran over $2B and MFP cuts U.S. comps 125bp; supply-side signals are limited.
